original.target_description: Main experiment: Time 2 cortisol, high-power versus low-power poses, controlling for baseline hormones, sex, and testosterone.

n.sample_role: Participant analytic N unresolved; recruitment count 42 only
n.exclusions: Two cortisol outliers excluded (>3 SD); one testosterone outlier also reported. Overlap and final membership of the covariate model are unspecified.
n.location: p.1368, Note 2; p.1364, Participants and overview of procedure
n.quote: Cortisol scores at both time points were sufficiently normally ... distributed, except for two outliers that were more than 3 standard ... deviations above the mean and were excluded;

notes: Identity verified from supplied complete six-page Research Report: Power Posing: Brief Nonverbal Displays Affect Neuroendocrine Levels and Risk Tolerance; Dana R. Carney, Amy J.C. Cuddy, and Andy J. Yap; Psychological Science 21(10), 1363–1368; DOI 10.1177/0956797610383437. Primary original report, not the Ranehill replication. No PDF supplied. Study 1 and named outcomes identify the main experiment; the additional study (N = 49) on p.1367 is excluded. Numerical main results are on printed p.1366 (document page 4), rather than supplied locator p.5. The source reports 42 recruited participants and hormone outlier exclusions, but no explicit analytic N for the critical hormone model. The model also controls for the other hormone; overlap of hormone exclusions and final model membership are unspecified. No analytic N inferred from degrees of freedom or recruitment minus exclusions. Requested r explicitly printed with the same-test F and p. No effect-size conversions performed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
